meta_description:
208K likes, 252 comments - vikram_official on June 25, 2026: "@vikram_official We are here to live, not to compete.

Life isn’t about proving what we have—it’s about appreciating who we are, growing every day, and creating meaningful memories.

Life is very short. Live every moment with gratitude. Smile often, because you never know when it might be your last. Be thankful for every blessing, and always trust the Divine.

Stay humble. Stay grateful. Live with purpose.".
